title: Un cours que chacun peut suivre
titleEn: A class more people can attend
summary: A community centre adjusts a course after asking learners about access, timing and materials.

sentences.fr: Awa aidait à organiser un cours de français pour des adultes qui travaillaient à des heures différentes.
sentences.en: Awa was helping organize a French class for adults who worked different hours.

sentences.fr: Avant de réserver la salle, elle a demandé aux participants quels jours leur convenaient le mieux.
sentences.en: Before booking the room, she asked participants which days suited them best.

sentences.fr: Deux personnes préféraient une séance en ligne, tandis que d'autres voulaient pratiquer en présence du groupe.
sentences.en: Two people preferred an online session, while others wanted to practise with the group in person.

sentences.fr: Une participante a signalé que l'entrée habituelle était difficile à utiliser avec une poussette.
sentences.en: One participant reported that the usual entrance was difficult to use with a stroller.

sentences.fr: Awa a transmis cette remarque au centre et a demandé quelles salles étaient accessibles.
sentences.en: Awa passed the comment to the centre and asked which rooms were accessible.

sentences.fr: Le centre a proposé une salle près de l'entrée et un lien pour les personnes qui ne pouvaient pas venir.
sentences.en: The centre offered a room near the entrance and a link for people who could not attend.
sentences.note: Ask people affected by a service about access barriers; an organizer may not notice every barrier from their own perspective.

sentences.fr: Awa a recommandé de tester les deux options, puis de revoir les inscriptions et les commentaires après un mois.
sentences.en: Awa recommended testing both options, then reviewing registrations and comments after one month.

quiz.prompt: Why did Awa ask participants about their preferred days?
options: The centre was closed for a month
quiz.explain: The first sentence explains that participants worked different hours.

quiz.prompt: What access issue did a participant report?
options: The class materials were too expensive
The room was too close to the entrance
The online link was too short
The usual entrance was difficult with a stroller
quiz.explain: The fourth sentence describes the stroller and entrance issue.

quiz.prompt: What did Awa recommend after the change?
options: Test both options and review feedback after a month
Move the course to another city
Keep only the online option permanently
quiz.explain: The final sentence recommends a trial and later review.
